messages:
mohit_sales: Heads-up — EU retail customer 'ShopMate' is asking for a Dedicated deployment. Core ask: baseline capacity for steady embeddings + chat, and the ability to burst to ~400 qps for a 2–6 hour flash-sale window. They need sizing + tentative pricing to push the deal. cc @elaine_pm @jon_dev
elaine_pm: thanks. do we know model families (embeddings vs chat), avg tokens /seq length, and regional constraints? also any compliance (data residency / k8s on-prem)?
mohit_sales: they use small chat assistant (instruction prompts, ~80 tokens output) + dense embeddings for search. traffic split ~60% embeddings, 40% chat. average request sizes: embeddings 1 call per user action (~768 dims model), chat avg 256 tokens input/80 output. EU-WEST region required, customer wants customer-managed KMS.
jon_dev: quick clarifying Qs: 1) are embeddings batched client-side or server-side? 2) what's peak concurrency shape — steady qps and spike profile?
lira_support: embeddings are currently single-shot per action from their app; no batching right now. peak shape: steady ~120 qps then flash up to 400 qps for ~3 hours in historical promos.
nana_sre: (typo) sorry, @ana_sre. for EU-WEST we need to confirm if Private (VPC) or Dedicated hosted. any PII concerns? encryption at rest with customer KMS changes onboarding timeline.
nana_sre: sorry again, ignore, meant @ana_sre
ana_sre: (this line left to preserve short-choppy Slack style)
ana_sre: tagging infra: if they want customer KMS + VPC, provisioning time + security review adds ~3w. is that acceptable?
mohit_sales: customer prefers VPC + KMS. timeline needs to fit Q3 pilot, so ~6 weeks. they accept a pilot with limited burst windows first.
jon_dev: rough sizing thought: baseline to cover steady 120 qps with headroom = X gpus. burst capacity needs pre-warmed nodes or very fast autoscale. prefer a hybrid policy: reserved baseline + burst pool of pre-warmed smaller instances. can sketch numbers after I plug into perf model.
jon_dev: quick calc snippet I ran locally: ```// simplified capacity calc
// embeddings throughputs (approx): 1 A10G ~ 60 embeds/s @ 768-dim (conservative)
// chat throughput: 1 A10G ~ 20 chats/s (256 tokens)
// steady: embeddings 0.6*120=72 qps -> ~2 A10G
// chat steady: 48 qps -> ~3 A10G
// baseline suggestion: 6 A10G (reserve 6 for steady + headroom)
// burst to 400 qps: additional ~10 A10G warm or faster H100 equivalents
```
greg_platform: thumbs up on hybrid. note that pre-warming 10 A10Gs in EU costs a fair bit and we need to check capacity commitments. Also consider quantized embedding model variant to reduce GPU footprint during bursts.
nana_sre: autoscale considerations: Kubernetes autoscaler cold-starts for new nodes ~5-7min. for 3hr flash we should use pre-warmed burst group or a fast-warm policy (keep N nodes idle).
\eliaine_pm: elaine_pm: tagging product: we need to convert this into a formal intake: acceptance criteria for pilot, perf targets (p95 latency embeddings <120ms, chat p95 <800ms), rollback/fallback (if burst can't be met route to hosted lower-SLA model), security checklist for KMS/VPC. can @jon_dev and @ana_sre propose a minimal spec doc?
jon_dev: I'll draft a short spec with sizing, autoscale policy options (pre-warm vs instant scale+graceful degrade), and cost delta table. should have by EOD tomorrow.
nana_sre: I'll add infra notes: KMS integration steps, required IAM, and provisioning lead times.
mohit_sales: perfect. also ask them for 7-day traffic sample and sample prompts + embedding dimension currently used. will loop them in.
lira_support: I'll reach out to get logs and a sample dataset.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: PROD-4621 — "ShopMate Dedicated: EU VPC + burst sizing intake" assigned to elaine_pm, jon_dev, ana_sre. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/PROD-4621 :rocket:
elaine_pm: actions: 1) @jon_dev spec draft 2) @ana_sre infra checklist 3) @mohit_sales gather traffic + sample prompts 4) me to create PRD and mark P2 pilot. target: PRD + spec ready in 5 business days.
mohit_sales: noted. I'll aim to have customer-provided telemetry by EOD Tue.
jon_dev: quick note: recommend we prepare two burst strategies in the PRD: A) conservative: pre-warm N nodes, guaranteed burst capacity; B) opportunistic: fast scale + degraded fidelity (quantized model fallback) if capacity misses. include cost comparison.
greg_platform: also add monitoring alerts: burst saturation, queueing time >200ms, and model-fallback count. that will help SRE during pilot.
elaine_pm: ok. thanks everyone. will update ticket with timelines and close the intake thread once PRD lands. :thumbsup:
